body:
1. In scripts/update-adlc-digests.mjs verifyAgainstLockfile(), normalize manifest field comparisons against package-lock.json by sorting object keys and stripping leading './' from bin paths (which npm strips in package-lock.json), fixing the publish.yml failure on @adlc/rails-guard@1.12.0.
2. In lib/worktrees.mjs createIntegrationWorktree(), use git clone --shared --no-tags --no-checkout followed by git checkout --detach <base> so commit-SHA base refs succeed without falling back to a linked git worktree, and guard git config writes behind an independent .git directory check so the host repository's .git/config is never mutated with user.name=agb-integrator.
3. Add regression tests in test/update-adlc-digests.test.mjs and test/worktrees.test.mjs and rebuild dist/.
title: Fix update-adlc-digests lockfile bin path/key normalization and createIntegrationWorktree .git/config isolation
